questions.prompt: Many customers find that product ____ is confusing and deceptive.
questions.explanation: “Product diversity” là sự đa dạng sản phẩm; cần danh từ làm chủ ngữ của “is”.

questions.prompt: For the ____ designer, this job is full of rewards and opportunities.
questions.explanation: Trước “designer” cần tính từ “enterprising”, chỉ nhà thiết kế có tinh thần chủ động, sáng tạo.

questions.prompt: Your full participation is ____ to our timely completion of this project.
questions.explanation: Sau “is” dùng tính từ “essential”; “essential to” nghĩa là thiết yếu đối với việc hoàn thành đúng hạn.

questions.prompt: We need to have a spare copier since the only one that is ____ is on its last leg.
questions.explanation: Sau “is” cần tính từ “functional”, mô tả chiếc máy còn hoạt động được.

questions.prompt: In order to ____ our lead in the market, we'll have to find a cheaper source of industrial supplies.
questions.explanation: Sau “in order to” dùng nguyên mẫu “maintain”, nghĩa là giữ vị trí dẫn đầu thị trường.

questions.prompt: She ____ changed the topic of conversation, thus preventing a disagreement between her colleagues from turning into an argument.
questions.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa “changed”; “smoothly” mô tả việc đổi chủ đề khéo léo để tránh cãi vã.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (16).
questions.explanation: Trước “supplies” cần tính từ “essential”, chỉ vật dụng thiết yếu.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (17).
questions.explanation: Sau “can” dùng nguyên mẫu “obtain”, nghĩa là có thể lấy/đặt được vật dụng trong ba ngày.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (18).
questions.explanation: “Function more smoothly” cần trạng từ mô tả cách văn phòng hoạt động suôn sẻ hơn.

Memo
To: All office staff
From: Luis Mendez, Office Manager
Re: Ordering office supplies
There has been a lot of confusion recently regarding the ordering of office supplies. In order to maintain a consistent
stock of [16] ____ supplies, from now on all supply orders must go through me. There are forms in my office that you
may use to order the supplies that you need. I can [17] ____ supplies for you within three days of receiving your order
form if it is filled out properly. By following this procedure, the office will function more [18] ____, and we can be sure
that we will always have quality supplies on hand when we need them. We will also avoid the problem of ordering
supplies that we already have. Thank you for your cooperation.

questions.prompt: When did the Supply Closet open?
questions.explanation: Thư đề ngày April 12 và nói mở cửa “last month”, nên cửa hàng mở tháng Ba.

questions.prompt: What can a customer get during his first visit to the store?
questions.explanation: Phiếu trong thư giảm 20% toàn bộ đơn hàng trong lần ghé đầu, tức khách được giảm giá.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't James Riley like the Riverdale Supply Company?

choiceTexts.A: It's too near the post office.
choiceTexts.D: It doesn't have a variety of merchandise.

questions.explanation: James muốn nhà cung cấp có “more diverse merchandise”, cho thấy nhà cung cấp cũ thiếu đa dạng.

questions.prompt: The word smoothly in line 8 of the letter is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: “Functioning smoothly” là hoạt động trôi chảy, không vướng trở ngại; gần nghĩa “easily”.

questions.prompt: The word maintain in line 3 of the memo is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: “Maintain an account” nghĩa là duy trì/giữ tài khoản đang có, gần nghĩa “keep”.

April 12
Dear Business Owner,
The Supply Closet, Inc., is a new office supply
store in your neighborhood. We opened last month
right across the street from the post office. We are
your local source for quality office supplies, including all office stationery, packing materials, folders,
pens, note pads, and more. We provide you with
the everyday items you need to keep your business
functioning smoothly. In order to introduce ourselves to you, we are enclosing a coupon for 20 percent off your entire purchase during your first visit
to the Supply Closet. Please visit us soon.
Sincerely yours,
Martha and Bill Heywood
Owners
Coupon expires June 30.

Memo
To: Gisela Freeman
From: James Riley
Re: New supply store
Please see the attached letter from the Supply Closet,
Inc. I think we should try them out. I know we
maintain an account with the Riverdale Supply
Company, but I am not completely satisfied with them
as a source for supplies. I would like to find a supplier
with more diverse merchandise. I'd like you to visit the
Supply Closet sometime this week and purchase some
stationery. We need to do a big mailing at the beginning of May, so we'll need some manila envelopes and
letter paper. You can use the coupon that came with
the letter. Look at the items they have for sale and see
how it compares with the Riverdale Supply Company.
If it looks like they're a better source for supplies, we
can start ordering from them regularly. Thank you.
